preview.title: Fluso Frontier Benchmark
preview.subtitle: Historical five-model comparable release built from the previous clean head-to-head run set

notes: Headline charts and claims are derived strictly from the clean comparable set.

insights.claim: GLM-5.1 leads the current comparable headline set on overall pass rate.
Kimi K2.6 is the lowest-cost clean run, but GLM-5.1 still leads the release on overall task completion.
Kimi K2.6 reaches a first user-visible reply faster than the rest of the clean set, but fastest does not automatically mean highest completion.
Memory behavior is the task family where the current models separate most clearly in this release.
